author: reek
body: Until 2026-07-28 the checker ACCEPTED this. The receiver fell through the field-access arms to the fresh-type-variable fallback, so `s.x` was given an unconstrained type and the compile ran on to emit, where it died with `CDX2000: emit-field-access: unresolved type for field 'x'` -- a message about the emitter's internals, at a phase the author has no reason to be reading, for a mistake the type system can see.

author: reek
body: The fallback it fell through is load-bearing for genuine inference, so the fix is this one arm rather than a change to the fallback.

author: reek
body: There is deliberately no unwrap suggested, because there is none. A unit over a record cannot be passed where the record is expected either: `spot-point : Spot -> Point` taking the identity is CDX2001, measured. A unit over a PRIMITIVE is transparent that way and works, which is the asymmetry that makes this shape surprising.
